title: Zesty Springy Indian Rice Vermicelli Chaat
description: A solo dinner Indian dish featuring rice vermicelli, coconut cream, and spices, this chaat is a satvik friendly and resinous treat. It has a springy texture from the vermicelli and a burst of flavor from the coconut cream crack.
instructions: Heat the ghee in a large pan over medium heat and add the cumin seeds.
Let the seeds sizzle for a few seconds before adding the coriander powder and garam masala.
Stir well and cook for 1 minute.
Add the rice vermicelli to the pan and stir to coat with the spice mixture.
Cook the vermicelli for 2-3 minutes or until it is slightly toasted.
Add the coconut cream to the pan and stir well to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and let cook for 2 minutes or until the cream has thickened slightly.
Stir in the salt, lime juice, and chopped cilantro.
Transfer the chaat to a serving dish and garnish with chopped green chilies.
